guidance.statement: We should stay in the volume region of about 8-10% for the full FY27.
guidance.quote: At the current stage, we are looking at the band of 8-10% for the full FY27.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

guidance.statement: We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds.
guidance.quote: We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

growth_commentary: Overall decorative volume growth was strong at about 9% for the quarter.
Decorative value grew at 16.6%, aided by a weighted price increase of about 6.8% and improved product mix.
Rural markets exhibited much better growth compared to urban markets.
B2B and industrial segments delivered robust performances, led by auto, marine, and general industrial growth.

pushback.question: Will you be happy with the 9% volume growth on a soft base of last year, and was there any negative impact of price hikes or regional factors?
pushback.answer: Demand conditions have been decent across all three months, though T1 and T2 cities saw lower growth compared to rural areas, and we landed within our predicted 8-10% band.

pushback.question: Given that costs went up by almost 25% against a 9-11% price increase, are we bracing for gross margin compression in Q2?
pushback.answer: While a large part of inflation will impact Q2, volatility also brings deflation in certain input categories, and our overall mix and sourcing efficiencies will govern margins.

pushback.question: How should one think about the product mix and the 7% pricing/value-volume gap this quarter given prior negative mix trends?
pushback.answer: The positive mix is driven by a strong focus on premiumization and newer innovations, and value will likely remain higher than volume until future pricing corrections.
